title: The merge tool and the guard refuse a merge or push to main while an open integration PR's CI run is in progress
why: Rule git-no-merge-during-batch-ci held no one on Nov 8: #2352 (19:19 CST) and #2350 (19:53 CST) were merged from the owner's account by a local session while #2361's CI ran, and each cancelled a run about 30 minutes in (coordinator 20:26 CST Nov 8).
note: Filed by triage, Nov 8 20:28 CST. A queue-landing fix. First check what main already enforces and why it did not fire. The refusal names the run and offers the owner's `override`. Lane session_013NEJKynokbBE1W2BNcp7hX (coordinator 20:29 CST Nov 8); its brief covers what main enforces and why it did not fire on #2352 and #2350.
